# R5.25 — Recompute frozen analysis through the native owner

## Summary

Lands the §6.3 **Recompute** recipient procedure inside `hh-analysis`
(the native owner): `recompute_analysis(&RecomputePlan, &AnalysisInput)
→ Result<RecomputeReport, AnalysisError>` — verify inputs, reconstruct
the frozen grade selection, reconcile planned slots, rerun the pinned
analysis through the one kernel, and compare under §6.3's frozen rules:
identities/membership/order/counts/categorical verdicts exact, estimate
scalars under `abs(new−reference) ≤ 1e−10 × max(1,abs(reference))` at
full precision; a threshold/verdict change fails even inside tolerance.
`reproduced` is arithmetic agreement only — never a hidden-history/
oracle/R-level claim. No `hh recompute` command (§6.3 — the recipe/CLI
owner is R5.28; outside review is R5.52).

## What changed

- `crates/hh-analysis/src/recompute.rs` — the owner interface:
  `verify_inputs` (withheld/malformed/nonfinite/wrong-pin refusals;
  `generated_from` + `report_id` exact) → `population` (the landed
  `assemble_receipt` over runs/tasks/pins folded from the same rebuilt
  input; non-`closed` → `SelectionNotClosed`) → `rerun` (`analyze`;
  kernel refusals verbatim) → `compare` (closed drift-kind set
  `identity`/`order`/`count`/`verdict`/`threshold`/`scalar`; the
  closed exact-member set never rides the tolerance); the
  `analysis-recompute/1` derived record.
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/error.rs` — `AnalysisError::Recompute`
  variant + `From` (one refusal vocabulary; `xerr` renders verbatim).
- `crates/hh-analysis/src/lib.rs` — module + exports.
- `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_25.rs` — 13-case battery over the EX-02
  fixture + a full `DeclaredReceipt` (see AC table).
- ADR-0403 (landing record), coverage dated note, BL-47 home, run
  ledger.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,468 changed source/test lines vs the ≤700 trigger (~2.1×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`f2dd2fac` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.25-split-review.md`):
one owner interface; no documented seam; each leg alone dead or
unverifiable; the battery's bulk is the irreducible EX-02 informative
fixture.
